verdict.rationale: Dagster's core model is asset/job definitions with explicit dependencies (deps=[...]) that the platform resolves into execution order, backed by schedules/sensors/declarative automation for orchestrating runs, and this is corroborated by hands-on runtime probes confirming a working project actually runs (dagster dev boots, webserver responds). Community feedback also affirms the asset-dependency approach as a core differentiator vs task-based tools. Missing for 10: independent large-scale production case study detailing complex DAG ordering at scale.
